title: Per-field lemmas assemble the compiler_t record in generic_compiler
intent: Build a value of the `compiler_t` record — whose four propositional fields are the start-address, end-address, soundness and completeness obligations — by proving each field as its own `Local Fact` and then closing all four at once with a single `exists link code; auto.` whose `auto` resolves each field through a `Hint Resolve`.

children.name: fst_ok
children.statement: Fact fst_ok : forall P i, link P i (fst P) = i.
children.note: Closes the gc_fst field of compiler_t (lines 252-259): link P i (fst P) = i. Analyst's paraphrase, replaced by the declaration's text: The linker maps the source program's start address to the compiled program's entry address.

children.name: out_ok
children.statement: Fact out_ok : forall P i j, out_code j P -> link P i j = code_end(i,code P i).
children.closed_by: unfold link, code_end; rewrite linker_out_err; then `unfold code; rewrite compiler_length; auto` and `lia`
children.note: Closes the gc_out field: out_code j P -> link P i j = code_end (i, code P i). Analyst's paraphrase, replaced by the declaration's text: At an exit position of P the linker points to the end of the compiled code.

children.name: sound
children.statement: Fact sound : forall P i, compiled_sound (link P i) P (i,code P i).
children.closed_by: apply compiler_sound; then `intros; apply compiler_subcode; auto`
children.note: Closes the gc_sound field: compiled_sound (link P i) P (i, code P i). Analyst's paraphrase, replaced by the declaration's text: The compiled program forward-simulates the source program (compiled_sound for the concrete linker and code).

children.name: complete
children.statement: Fact complete : forall P i, compiled_complete (link P i) P (i,code P i).
children.closed_by: destruct compiler_complete' (then compiler_subcode, sss_compute_stop, linker_out_code, lia)
children.note: Closes the gc_complete field: compiled_complete (link P i) P (i, code P i). Analyst's paraphrase, replaced by the declaration's text: The compiled program backward-simulates the source program (compiled_complete for the concrete linker and code).

applicability.goal_shape: A goal whose target is a record or structure type with a small fixed set of propositional fields, each an obligation to prove; here `compiler_t` (lines 252-259) with fields gc_fst, gc_out, gc_sound, gc_complete, the data fields gc_link/gc_code being filled by the explicit witnesses `link` and `code`.
applicability.use_when: the record's fields are independent enough to prove one lemma each; the assembly is uniform (`exists <ctor args>; auto` with the per-field lemmas registered in a Hint Resolve database); the record is built more than once so the per-field lemmas are reusable.
applicability.avoid_when: the fields share a non-trivial invariant that must be threaded between them (then one key-invariant lemma beats four leaves); a field's proof depends on another field's statement; the hint database is too broad for `auto` to resolve the fields reliably.

claims.claim: The authors describe the two halves of the argument as deriving 'soundness and completeness of the compiled program Q wrt the source program P' from per-instruction semantic correctness and whole-program syntactic correctness.

The same record assembly — destruct the record, then `exists gc_link gc_code; auto.` with the two non-auto fields proved explicitly — is reused in `compiler_t_simul_equiv` (lines 375-390) of the same file.

metrics.how_counted: the parent's proof body is the single line `exists link code; auto.` (line 311); all four record fields are discharged by that `auto` through `Hint Resolve ... : core` (line 307), so each of the 4 children is closed by automation in the glue; the children's own proofs are 1, 8, 5 and 17 lines respectively

consequences: The move turns the record into one obligation per propositional field, each closed by a named `Local Fact`, so the parent is a bare `exists link code; auto.`. It creates a hidden dependency: `auto` discharges the fields only because `Hint Resolve fst_ok out_ok sound complete : core.` (line 307) registered them, so removing the hint silently breaks the glue. It also obscures which lemma closes which field — the reader must consult the record's field order (lines 252-259) to map fst_ok→gc_fst, out_ok→gc_out, sound→gc_sound, complete→gc_complete. Failure modes: a field whose statement is not exactly the record field's type will not resolve under `auto`; interdependent fields cannot be split into independent leaves.
